criteria.subject_recognition: The principal subject is immediately recognizable at actual phone size, with enough picture space to understand its action.
criteria.contact_and_consequence: Objects have visible support and continuous identity; contact produces the depicted change, with a completed readable result.
criteria.dominant_action: The focal subject performs the narrated transformation. Peripheral motion, an overlay label or camera drift cannot supply missing action.
criteria.surface_finish: Inspect native detail as well as phone size. Surfaces, thickness, joints, light and shadows must look finished for the chosen style.
criteria.continuity: Each cut conserves a recognizable subject or explicitly introduces a sourced example; do not imply stock illustration is the actual case.
criteria.closing_payoff: The closing image answers the opening question and makes the source limit understandable without inventing a case outcome.
criteria.sound: Use actual audible-media evidence for voice, masking, sync and motivated sound. Never infer a listening verdict from captions.

review_rule: Ground blocking findings in a timed observed defect and its effect on comprehension or finish. Distinguish uncertainty and optional preferences without weakening mandatory standards. Readable evidence and completed-result holds are judged for their purpose; continuous motion alone earns no approval. A weakest interval is required even for a passing film. A preference for another style is not itself a blocking defect. Existing rubric hard fails, cinematic requirements and source limits remain mandatory.
